name: Grand Theft Auto V: Special Edition
storyline: In 2004, a bank robbery in the small town of Ludendorff goes wrong, leaving criminal Michael Townley presumed dead. Nine years later, Michael lives in Los Santos under the alias Michael De Santa, hiding under a deal with a federal agent. Across town, Franklin Clinton, a young man working for a corrupt car salesman, crosses paths with Michael and the two form an unlikely friendship. When Michael is forced back into crime to pay off a debt to a dangerous drug lord, he enlists Franklin as his partner. Their activities draw out Trevor Philips, Michael's volatile former associate who had believed Michael was killed years ago. Trevor forces his way back into Michael's life, and the three protagonists find themselves pulled deeper into a web of heists, government corruption, and powerful enemies on all sides.
summary:
The Grand Theft Auto V Special Edition includes:
- Full retail copy of Grand Theft Auto V
- Collectible SteelBook with exclusive artwork featuring custom colour and metallic treatments for the Michael, Trevor and Franklin design
- Blueprint map (21.5” x 26.75”) displaying a blueprint view of Los Santos and Blaine County
- Special ability boost that allows Michael, Franklin and Trevor’s special ability bars to regenerate 25% faster
- Stunt Plane Trials offering additional single-player aerial challenges across Los Santos and Blaine County
- Bonus outfits, tattoos and special shop deals for Michael, Franklin and Trevor
- Additional weapons available for free at Ammu-Nation in single-player: Pistol .50, Bullpup Shotgun and Hammer
